Kerry Condon
**Kerry Condon** (born 9 January 1983) is an Irish actress. She was the youngest actress to play [Ophelia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ophelia) in a [Royal Shakespeare Company](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Royal_Shakespeare_Company) production of [Hamlet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hamlet) (2001–2002).<sup>[1]</sup> She played [Octavia of the Julii](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Octavia_of_the_Julii) in [Rome](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rome_%28TV_series%29) (2005–2007),<sup>[2][3]</sup> [Stacey Ehrmantraut](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stacey_Ehrmantraut) in [Better Call Saul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Better_Call_Saul) (2015–2022), and is the voice of the [artificial intelligence](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_intelligence) entity [F.R.I.D.A.Y.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/F.R.I.D.A.Y.) in various films in the [Marvel Cinematic Universe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marvel_Cinematic_Universe).
